subject: Signal and System
questionText:
For an input x[n], output y[n] of a system is related as 
y[n] = x[n] + n. The system is  
 
(a) linear, time-invariant, and stable 
 
(b)  non-linear, time-variant, and unstable 
(c)
linear time invariant and unstable
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-07 (Types of System).
